name: Database Info
description: Display information about your database model (tables, columns, indexes, sizes, row counts).
project_description: Database Info (machine name database_info_schema, info.yml name "Database Info Drush Command") is a small developer/diagnostic tool that reports on the site's own database. It reads the MySQL/MariaDB INFORMATION_SCHEMA and per-table DESCRIBE / SHOW INDEX output to show the database name, character set / collation, total size in MB, the list of tables with their row counts and on-disk sizes, and — per table — the column definitions (name, type, nullability, key) and indexes. It exposes this two ways: a Drush command (db:info, alias dbi) and two admin web pages (/admin/database/info and /admin/database/table/{tablename}). It has no configuration form, no permissions of its own, no config schema, and no third-party dependencies; core ^10 || ^11.
